description: This Java class, VariableInstallmentsFlatHelper, provides utility methods for creating, modifying, and verifying loan installment variations within integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to construct JSON payloads for loan product creation, loan application, and installment modifications, as well as helper functions for date formatting and data construction used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: VariableInstallmentsFlatHelper
classes.description: A helper class for constructing JSON payloads and test data related to variable installment loans in integration tests for Apache Fineract.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithVaribleConfig
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string for creating a loan product with variable installment configuration, including principal, repayment terms, interest rate, amortization, and accounting rules.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Builds a JSON string for submitting a loan application with specified client, product, charges, and collateral details.
